description: A shell script designed to detect crashes or bugs related to the ath10k driver, gather system information, and prepare bug report files in a designated directory.

methods.name: bugcheck_generic
methods.description: Collects system information such as uname, os-release, dmesg, cpuinfo, meminfo, cmdline, and lsmod, and saves it into the info.txt file in the crash directory.

methods.name: roll_crashes
methods.description: Prepares the crash directory by rotating existing crash data and creating a fresh directory for new crash reports.
